# The Shadow Bridge

> Founded by Pratibha Mishra (11+ years in Special Education, Child Psychology & School Counselling), The Shadow Bridge connects families and schools across India with background-verified Shadow Teachers, Special Education Home Tutors, and Specialized Therapists for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), ADHD, Down Syndrome, speech delays, and learning disabilities.

Transparent placement-based pricing: Parent Intake Consultation is ₹99 (School Consultation is ₹199). One-time placement fees apply only after matching: Shadow Teacher Placement is ₹5,000, Special Education Home Tutor Placement is ₹3,000, Home & Online Therapy / Online Parent Training Booking is ₹2,000, and School Collaboration Placement is ₹5,000 per requested teacher.

Geographic coverage: In-person Shadow Teaching and Home Tutoring operate across 6 Indian metros — Delhi NCR (Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad), Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Pune. In-home Therapy Sessions serve Delhi NCR, while ABA Online Therapy and Online Parent Training are available PAN-India.

## Specialized Therapy Programs

- [Therapies Hub](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies): Complete directory of 10 in-home (Delhi NCR) and online (PAN-India) clinical therapy programs (₹2,000 placement booking).
- [ABA Online Therapy (PAN India)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/aba-online-therapy): Live 1-on-1 telehealth Applied Behavior Analysis sessions nationwide.
- [Online Parent Training (PAN India)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/online-parent-training): Live 1-on-1 virtual parent coaching on ABA routines, visual schedules, and meltdown management.
- [In-Home ABA Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/aba-therapy): Structured in-home Applied Behavior Analysis for Autism and ADHD.
- [Speech Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/speech-therapy): Home speech and language therapy for articulation, speech delay, and functional communication.
- [Occupational Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/occupational-therapy): Sensory integration, fine/gross motor skills, handwriting, and daily independence.
- [Special Education Tutoring (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/special-education): Multisensory remedial instruction and Individualized Education Program (IEP) support.
- [Behavior Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/behavior-therapy): Positive behavior plans for emotional regulation, tantrums, and anxiety.
- [Physical Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/physical-therapy): Pediatric motor strength, balance, posture, and gait therapy at home.
- [Play Therapy (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/play-therapy): Child-centered therapeutic play for emotional expression and social bonding.
- [Counseling & Psychological Support (Delhi NCR)](https://www.theshadowbridge.com/therapies/counseling-psychological-support): Confidential child psychology and parent counseling sessions.
